label: rare near-threshold firing around <DEL> / first copy step, enriched for first token r and earlier q
explanation: Very sparse feature (0.007% of steps). Activations are weak (median 0.116, max 0.179) and look like near-threshold firing. About 82% of mass falls on the delimiter step (recall_idx 0) and the first copy step (recall_idx 1). It is enriched when the first original token is r (13.8x lift), when the input is r, and when the previous input is q (11x). It never fires at t<3 or t>10, and never past recall_idx 2. Even the best predicate (copy step 1 with input r) only gets precision ~0.01 and recall ~0.31, since the vast majority of matching contexts stay inactive. Adding a condition on whether q appears in the original tokens raises precision only to ~0.03. No coherent predicate captures it.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=r (+3.30), prev_tok=z (+3.17), prev_tok=q (+3.07), orig1=h (+2.98), orig0=h (+2.91), recall_idx=1 (+2.56). Lower it: phase=2 (-3.12), prev3_tok=- (-2.20), in_count=2 (-1.68), phase=0 (-1.33).
